# Long sentences

The courier who left the mill before the bells rang walked along the river path, past the old bridge, to reach the town.
The courier rests.

The courier carries `one very small and quite heavy parcel` across the windy hills every single morning of the cold month.

12. The courier carries one parcel across the windy hills every single morning of the cold and wet month here today.
